grammar.title: The Subjunctive for Medical Recommendations
grammar.explanation:
In medical contexts, doctors often use the subjunctive mood after expressions of recommendation, necessity, or desire:

• Es importante que + subjunctive:
  Es importante que tome la medicina cada ocho horas. - It's important that you take the medicine every eight hours.

• Le recomiendo que + subjunctive:
  Le recomiendo que descanse durante una semana. - I recommend that you rest for a week.

• Es necesario que + subjunctive:
  Es necesario que se haga los análisis. - It's necessary that you get the tests done.

Present subjunctive formation: -ar verbs → -e endings; -er/-ir verbs → -a endings.
  tomar → tome; comer → coma; dormir → duerma
